description: Lowest nightly hotel prices for a city and stay dates from Google Hotels' public results page (about 18-20 hotels, Google's order): hotel name, 'prices starting from' amount, currency as Google shows it (it follows the server's region, so check the currency field) and Google's deal flag with % below usual. Confirms the dates Google applied. Not a booking; prices change constantly. Usually answers in about 8 s, up to 15 s on slower calls; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: travel_google_flights when you need One-way flight options with prices from Google Flights; travel_google_travel when you need Google Travel hotels and vacation rentals for a place. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

checkin.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, today or later (required)

checkout.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD, after check-in, at most 30 nights (required)

place.description: City or area, e.g. Paris, Tokyo Shinjuku (required)

name: travel_google_hotels_price
title: Lowest nightly hotel prices for a city and stay dates
